content: Repair C/pthreads synchronization while preserving all original work, scheduling hooks, interfaces and protected tests. Return ONLY a JSON object with one key "files": an object mapping each editable filename to its complete corrected source. Do not include Markdown, explanations, commands, tests, or new files. JSON-encode each source string exactly once: source newlines become JSON \n escapes, and quotes/backslashes must decode to the original C syntax. Put the lock before the shared read, preserve the shared write, and synchronize all readers. Never replace sched_yield with another API.
